record_classification.ACTUAL_EXECUTION_AUDIT_RESULT: A record representing an observed tool/run/audit/scan/verifier output rather than only a fixture expectation.
record_classification.EXPECTED_GOLDEN_FIXTURE: A frozen expected/golden/test result used to verify implementation semantics; useful for structural recurrence but not counted toward the minimum actual-output requirement.
record_classification.STRUCTURAL_OR_PARSER_FIXTURE: A machine-readable test/parser/configuration-shaped object selected by path filter but not itself a result semantics record.
record_classification.OTHER_MACHINE_READABLE_RECORD: A selected JSON that does not fit the three classes above; retain rather than replace.

HIDDEN-001_NON_TRANSITIVE_EVIDENCE_BINDI.STRONG: The selected record explicitly preserves distinct evidence/result stages such that evidence or success at stage N licenses, enables, or is necessary for stage N+1 but does not itself establish the downstream verification/admissibility/policy/outcome state.
HIDDEN-001_NON_TRANSITIVE_EVIDENCE_BINDI.WEAK: Multiple stages or result layers are present and separable, but the non-transitive promotion boundary is only implied or not operationally explicit.
HIDDEN-001_NON_TRANSITIVE_EVIDENCE_BINDI.CONTRADICTION: The record explicitly treats upstream evidence/success as automatically establishing a separately represented downstream claim despite acknowledging that downstream stage as distinct.
HIDDEN-001_NON_TRANSITIVE_EVIDENCE_BINDI.NOT_APPLICABLE: No meaningful staged evidence/result promotion relation is represented.

HIDDEN-002_AMBIGUITY_IS_A_FIRST_CLASS_ST.STRONG: The selected record explicitly preserves a non-binary state such as unknown, unresolved, skipped, unscanned, inconclusive, not-applicable, partial, unevaluated, or equivalent rather than forcing a binary pass/fail or present/absent result.
HIDDEN-002_AMBIGUITY_IS_A_FIRST_CLASS_ST.WEAK: Optional/missing/empty-state semantics preserve some uncertainty but without an explicit epistemic or evaluability distinction.
HIDDEN-002_AMBIGUITY_IS_A_FIRST_CLASS_ST.CONTRADICTION: Known unresolved/unevaluated evidence is explicitly collapsed into a binary final state while the record still represents the unresolved condition.

HIDDEN-003_FIRST_BREAK_LOCALIZATION_GENE.STRONG: The selected record represents an ordered stage/check chain in which the earliest failed or blocked boundary is retained and materially localizes why downstream stages are not treated as reached.
HIDDEN-003_FIRST_BREAK_LOCALIZATION_GENE.WEAK: Ordered statuses/checks exist, but first-failure position is not itself preserved as a meaningful localization boundary. Generic unordered failed checks are at most WEAK.
HIDDEN-003_FIRST_BREAK_LOCALIZATION_GENE.CONTRADICTION: The record discards first-break position while explicitly claiming equivalent localization of failure in an ordered chain.
HIDDEN-003_FIRST_BREAK_LOCALIZATION_GENE.NOT_APPLICABLE: No ordered prerequisite/check chain suitable for first-break localization is represented.

HIDDEN-006_NEGATIVE_CLAIM_CLOSED_SEARCH_.STRONG: A non-detection, zero finding, unknown, unresolved, or negative result is explicitly scoped to the scan/search/evaluation coverage and/or detection sensitivity, and a broader absence claim is blocked when that coverage or sensitivity is incomplete, unknown, filtered, or otherwise narrower than the claim scope.
HIDDEN-006_NEGATIVE_CLAIM_CLOSED_SEARCH_.WEAK: The negative/empty result carries explicit scope/filter/coverage qualifiers, but the record does not itself state or encode the boundary against broader absence inference.
HIDDEN-006_NEGATIVE_CLAIM_CLOSED_SEARCH_.CONTRADICTION: A global absence conclusion is explicitly asserted from a search/scan/evaluation universe that the same record identifies as incomplete, partial, filtered, unevaluated, or sensitivity-limited.
HIDDEN-006_NEGATIVE_CLAIM_CLOSED_SEARCH_.NOT_APPLICABLE: No non-detection-to-absence or search-coverage relation is represented.

anti_overfit_rules: Do not infer a pattern from filenames alone; classification requires selected JSON body evidence after this rubric is frozen.
Do not replace any of the 21 selected records after body inspection.
Do not replace the zero-eligible CodeQL repository.
Do not count multiple records from one repository as multiple governance-independent supports.
Do not count a generic null, empty array, false boolean, or missing field as HIDDEN-002 without ambiguity/evaluability semantics.
Do not count a generic list of failed checks as HIDDEN-003 STRONG unless ordering plus earliest-boundary significance is represented.
Do not count zero findings as HIDDEN-006 STRONG unless scope/coverage/sensitivity constrains the admissible negative claim.
Do not use Panel A results to satisfy Panel B thresholds.
Do not reinterpret CONTRADICTION as NOT_APPLICABLE to preserve promotion eligibility.

repository_level_collapse.rule: For each HIDDEN and repository, collapse selected records to the strongest observed classification with CONTRADICTION overriding all support: CONTRADICTION > STRONG > WEAK > NOT_APPLICABLE.

destructive_rewire_gate.purpose: specificity calibration after external recurrence; never a rescue or discovery mechanism
